recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the published FHIR-13426 application in current build-scope source without changing document-specific profile requirements.
issue_request: FHIR-13426 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for STU3 and requested Composition wording be generalized beyond the Document paradigm, replacing document-only wording with package wording and applying document requirements only in document context.
initial_application: Historical commit 43a79eb084 applied the issue to the then-authoritative Composition spreadsheet by changing the root definition from a single logical document to a single logical package, but current active narrative and the catalog profile still retained document-only wording after source refactoring.
additional_context: The Composition resource is active in source/fhir.ini. The May 2017 Zulip Paradigms thread confirms the intended interpretation that Composition can be used outside document Bundles while document obligations apply to document usage. FHIR-25438 is a later applied issue on the same text family and is decided separately in this result.
reconciliation: Updated source/composition/composition-introduction.xml to introduce Composition as a coherent package, make document Bundle content conditional on document use, and avoid implying every section must contain narrative. Updated source/composition/structuredefinition-profile-catalog.xml so its inherited root definition uses package wording.
source_changes: source/composition/composition-introduction.xml: generalized the Scope and Usage and Boundaries prose from document-only wording to coherent-package wording and qualified document Bundle rules by document context.

source/composition/structuredefinition-profile-catalog.xml: changed the catalog profile root definition from single logical document to single logical package.
